source.text: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ λέγων· Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

records.literal_gloss: In then the days those comes John the Baptist preaching in the wilderness of the Judea \v 2 and saying, Repent, has come near for the kingdom of the heavens.

en.L: In those days John the Baptist comes, preaching in the wilderness of Judea \v 2 and saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has come near."
en.B: In those days John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness of Judea with a message. \v 2 "Repent," he proclaimed, "because the kingdom of heaven has come near."
en.R: At that time John the Baptist came to the desert land of Judea and preached to the people. \v 2 He said, "Turn away from your sins and come back to God, because the kingdom of heaven is coming near."

es.L: Y en aquellos días se presenta Juan el Bautista, proclamando en el desierto de Judea \v 2 y diciendo: «{{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}}, porque se ha acercado el reino de los cielos».
es.B: En aquellos días apareció Juan el Bautista en el desierto de Judea con un mensaje. \v 2 «{{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}}», proclamaba, «porque el reino de los cielos ya se ha acercado».
es.R: En ese tiempo, Juan el Bautista llegó a la región desierta de Judea y le predicaba a la gente. \v 2 Decía: «{{plural_you:Apártense de sus|Apartaos de vuestros}} pecados y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a Dios, porque el reino de los cielos se está acercando».

fr.L: Or en ces jours-là paraît Jean le Baptiste, proclamant dans le désert de Judée \v 2 et disant : « Repentez-vous, car le royaume des cieux s’est approché. »
fr.B: En ces jours-là, Jean le Baptiste parut dans le désert de Judée avec un message. \v 2 « Repentez-vous, proclamait-il, car le royaume des cieux s’est approché. »
fr.R: À cette époque, Jean le Baptiste est venu dans le désert de Judée, et il s’est mis à parler aux gens. \v 2 Il disait : « Détournez-vous de vos péchés et revenez à Dieu, car le royaume des cieux est tout proche. »

sw.L: Basi katika siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji anajitokeza, akitangaza katika nyika ya Uyahudi \v 2 akisema, "Tubuni, kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni umekaribia."
sw.B: Katika siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji alitokea katika nyika ya Uyahudi akiwa na ujumbe. \v 2 Alitangaza, "Tubuni, kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni umekaribia."
sw.R: Wakati huo Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja katika eneo la jangwa la Uyahudi, akawahubiria watu. \v 2 Alisema, "Acheni dhambi zenu mrudi kwa Mungu, kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni unakaribia."

ko.L: 그 날들에 세례자 요한이 유대 광야에 나타나 선포하며 \v 2 말한다. "회개하여라. 천국이 가까이 왔기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그 무렵에 세례자 요한이 유대 광야에 나타나서 이렇게 선포했다. \v 2 "회개하여라. 천국이 가까이 왔다."
ko.R: 그 무렵 세례자 요한이 유대 지방의 빈 들에 와서 사람들에게 하나님의 말씀을 전했다. \v 2 요한이 말했다. "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오너라. 천국이 가까이 오고 있다."

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy, Giăng Báp-tít xuất hiện, rao giảng trong đồng hoang xứ Giu-đê \v 2 và nói: "Hãy ăn năn, vì vương quốc thiên đàng đã đến gần."
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, Giăng Báp-tít xuất hiện trong đồng hoang xứ Giu-đê và rao giảng: \v 2 "Hãy ăn năn, vì vương quốc thiên đàng đã đến gần."
vi.R: Lúc ấy, Giăng Báp-tít đến vùng sa mạc thuộc xứ Giu-đê và giảng cho dân chúng. \v 2 Ông nói: "Hãy từ bỏ tội lỗi, quay về với Đức Chúa Trời, vì vương quốc thiên đàng đang đến gần."

am.L: በዚያም ወራት መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ እየሰበከ ይመጣል፤ \v 2 እንዲህም ይላል፦ «ንስሓ ግቡ፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና።»
am.B: በዚያ ዘመን መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ መልእክት ይዞ ተገለጠ። \v 2 «ንስሓ ግቡ» እያለ ያውጅ ነበር፤ «መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለች።»
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ወደ ይሁዳ በረሃ መጥቶ ለሕዝቡ ይሰብክ ነበር። \v 2 እንዲህም አለ፦ «ኃጢአታችሁን ትታችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ፤ የሰማይ መንግሥት እየቀረበች ነውና።»

decisions.choice: in those days: a loose link, years after chapter 2
alternatives: the same time as the move to Nazareth
decisions.reason: The phrase is a common way to open a new part of the story. Jesus is now a grown man (3:13).

decisions.choice: repent: change one's mind and way of life, turning back to God
decisions.reason: The word means a change of mind. In the prophets' call to Israel to return to God, it is a turning of the whole life, which John asks to see in deeds (3:8).

decisions.choice: the kingdom of heaven: God's rule, the kingdom of God
alternatives: a place in heaven where people go after death
decisions.reason: Matthew nearly always says "kingdom of heaven" where Mark and Luke say "kingdom of God" (compare 4:17 with Mark 1:15), as Jews often spoke of heaven out of reverence for God's name. It is God's reign coming to earth, as in the prayer "your kingdom come" (6:10).

decisions.choice: has come near: it is close at hand, already pressing in
decisions.reason: The perfect tense says the kingdom has drawn near and is now close. Jesus will announce it in the same words (4:17).

decisions.choice: the kingdom of heaven (B, R); the kingdom of the heavens (L)
decisions.reason: "Heavens" is plural in Greek, following Hebrew. Balanced and Readable say "heaven", as English does, and keep Matthew's phrase, which the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: turn away from your sins and come back to God; the desert land
decisions.reason: Readable says what repenting means, and calls the wilderness by a word new readers know. It was dry, empty country, not sand desert.

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase for the kingdom of God (meaning decision m3), used through the book. Spanish keeps the plural "cielos" at every level, where English keeps it only at Literal, because "el reino de los cielos" is the natural Spanish phrase.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}}
decisions.reason: John speaks to the crowds, so every plural "you" takes the reader setting: "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) or "vosotros" (Spain). English has no such choice. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); historic presents kept as presents at Literal ("paraît", "arrive", "laisse")
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 1-2 and the other Gospels: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: le royaume des cieux at every level (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet. English Balanced and Readable say "heaven", but French keeps the plural "des cieux", which is the set phrase in French and is not hard for new readers; the meaning note says it is God's rule (m3). "Royaume" as in Mark's and Luke's "royaume de Dieu".

decisions.choice: repentez-vous, la repentance (L, B); détournez-vous de vos péchés et revenez à Dieu (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Mark: Readable says what repenting means (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase for the kingdom of God (meaning decision m3), used through the book. "Ufalme wa mbinguni" (the kingdom in heaven) is the natural Swahili phrase at every level; Swahili does not mark the Greek plural "heavens".

decisions.choice: Tubuni (L, B); Acheni dhambi zenu mrudi kwa Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Kutubu" is the word for repentance through Matthew (meaning decision m2). Readable spells out the turning from sin and back to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "천국" at every level, through Matthew
decisions.reason: "천국" is the word Korean readers know for Matthew's phrase, and in Korean it means the reign and realm of heaven, not only a place after death; the meaning decision says it is God's rule. Literal does not spell out "the kingdom of the heavens" ("하늘들의 나라"), so that the term reads the same at every level; Matthew's "heaven", where Mark and Luke say "God", stays visible.

decisions.choice: "회개하여라" (L, B); "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오너라" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark: "회개" is the established word; Readable says what it means, turning from sin back to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "세례자 요한" at every level; "광야" (L, B), "빈 들" (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses the noun "the Baptist" as a title, so every level says "세례자", as Mark's Balanced and Readable do. The wilderness words follow Mark.

decisions.choice: historic present kept in Literal ("말한다"), through Matthew 3; past in Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As docs/korean-style.md section 3 asks for the historic present; one note for the passage.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc thiên đàng" for the kingdom of heaven, at every level and through Matthew
decisions.reason: Mark's "kingdom of God" is "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" in Vietnamese, so Matthew's phrase keeps "vương quốc" for God's rule as king, with the familiar "thiên đàng" for "the heavens". Literal does not copy the Greek plural, which is a Hebrew way of saying "heaven". "Nước Trời" is the Catholic form, and "nước" now reads first as "country". A reviewer should check that "thiên đàng" is not heard only as the place of the dead; the meaning decision says the phrase means God's rule.

decisions.choice: "Hãy ăn năn" (L, B); "Hãy từ bỏ tội lỗi, quay về với Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:4 and 1:15: "ăn năn" is the Protestant word for repentance; Readable unfolds it as the English Readable does. "Đã đến gần" (L, B) and "đang đến gần" (R) also follow Mark 1:15. The same in 4:17.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal by leaving out "đã" ("xuất hiện"; also 3:13, 3:15 and the temptation in 4:5-11)
decisions.reason: As the style guide says, Literal keeps Matthew's present-tense storytelling by not adding "đã"; Balanced and Readable tell it as plain narrative.

decisions.choice: መንግሥተ ሰማያት (L, B); የሰማይ መንግሥት (the kingdom of heaven, R)
decisions.reason: "መንግሥተ ሰማያት" is the established church form of Matthew's phrase, and its plural keeps the Greek "heavens". It is Ge'ez in shape, so Readable uses the everyday Amharic "የሰማይ መንግሥት". Matthew's own wording is kept rather than replaced by "the kingdom of God", which means the same thing (see the meaning decision). This holds through the book.

decisions.choice: ንስሓ ግቡ (repent, L, B); ኃጢአታችሁን ትታችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ (leave your sins and come back to God, R)
decisions.reason: "ንስሓ ግቡ" is the living word for turning back to God; "ተጸጸቱ" says only that one feels regret. Readable spells out the change of life, as the English Readable does, because the church phrase can sound like a rite of confession.

source.text: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: This for is the [one] spoken through Isaiah the prophet saying, Voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of Lord, straight make the paths of him.

en.L: For this is the one spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, "[The] voice of one crying out in the wilderness: 'Prepare the way of [the] Lord, make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} paths straight.'"
en.B: John is the one the prophet Isaiah spoke of when he said, "A voice is calling out in the wilderness: 'Prepare the way of the Lord, straighten the roads {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will travel.'"
en.R: The prophet Isaiah spoke about John when he said, "Someone is shouting in the desert: 'Get the road ready for the Lord! Make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} paths straight!'"

es.L: Porque este es el [que fue] anunciado por medio de Isaías el profeta, que dice: «Voz de uno que clama en el desierto: “{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} el camino del Señor, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} rectas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sendas”».
es.B: Juan es la persona a la que se refería el profeta Isaías cuando dijo: «Una voz grita en el desierto: “{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} el camino del Señor, {{plural_you:enderecen|enderezad}} los caminos por donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pasará”».
es.R: El profeta Isaías habló de Juan cuando dijo: «Alguien grita en el desierto: “¡{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} el camino para el Señor! ¡{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} rectas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sendas!”».

fr.L: Car c’est lui dont il a été parlé par l’intermédiaire d’Isaïe le prophète, disant : « Voix de quelqu’un qui crie dans le désert : “Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, rendez droits {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sentiers.” »
fr.B: C’est de Jean qu’avait parlé le prophète Isaïe, quand il disait : « Une voix crie dans le désert : “Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, aplanissez les routes où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} passera.” »
fr.R: Le prophète Isaïe parlait de Jean quand il a dit : « Quelqu’un crie dans le désert : “Préparez la route pour le Seigneur ! Rendez {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins bien droits !” »

sw.L: Kwa sababu huyu ndiye yule aliyetajwa kupitia Isaya nabii, akisema, "Sauti ya mtu anayepaza sauti nyikani: 'Iandaeni njia ya Bwana, yafanyeni mapito {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanyooke.'"
sw.B: Yohana ndiye ambaye nabii Isaya alimtaja aliposema, "Sauti inaita nyikani: 'Mwandalieni Bwana njia, nyoosheni barabara atakazopita.'"
sw.R: Nabii Isaya alizungumza kuhusu Yohana aliposema, "Mtu anapiga kelele jangwani: 'Mtengenezeeni Bwana njia! Nyoosheni mapito {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!'"

ko.L: 이 사람은 이사야 예언자를 통하여 말씀하신 바로 그 사람이다. [그 말씀은] 이러하다. "광야에서 외치는 사람의 소리[가 들린다]. '주님의 길을 준비하여라. 그분의 오솔길들을 곧게 만들어라.'"
ko.B: 요한은 이사야 예언자가 말한 바로 그 사람이다. 이사야는 이렇게 말했다. "광야에서 외치는 사람의 소리가 있다. '주님의 길을 준비하여라. 그분이 다니실 길을 곧게 내어라.'"
ko.R: 이사야 예언자가 요한에 대해 이렇게 말했다. "빈 들에서 누군가가 외치고 있다. '주님께서 오실 길을 준비하여라! 그분이 다니실 길을 곧게 만들어라!'"

vi.L: Vì chính ông là người đã được nói đến qua nhà tiên tri Ê-sai, rằng: "Tiếng của [người] kêu lên trong đồng hoang: 'Hãy dọn đường của Chúa, hãy làm cho thẳng các lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'"
vi.B: Giăng chính là người mà nhà tiên tri Ê-sai đã nói đến: "Có tiếng kêu lên trong đồng hoang: 'Hãy dọn đường cho Chúa, hãy sửa cho thẳng những lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đi.'"
vi.R: Nhà tiên tri Ê-sai đã nói về Giăng như sau: "Có người đang kêu lớn trong sa mạc: 'Hãy dọn đường sẵn cho Chúa! Hãy làm thẳng các lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi!'"

am.L: ይህ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ በኩል የተነገረለት ነውና፤ እንዲህ ሲል፦ «በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ [ሰው] ድምፅ፦ “የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ፤ ጥርጊያዎቹንም ቀና አድርጉ።”»
am.B: ዮሐንስ ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ብሎ የተናገረለት ሰው ነው፦ «በምድረ በዳ እንዲህ ብሎ የሚጣራ ድምፅ አለ፦ “የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ፤ የሚጓዝባቸውንም መንገዶች አቅኑ።”»
am.R: ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ ስለ ዮሐንስ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናግሮ ነበር፦ «አንድ ሰው በበረሃ እንዲህ እያለ ይጮኻል፦ “ለጌታ መንገዱን አዘጋጁ! የሚሄድባቸውን መንገዶች ቀጥ አድርጉ!”»

decisions.choice: Isaiah 40:3: the voice that prepares the Lord's road home
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 40 a voice calls for a road to be made ready for God, who is coming to bring his people back from exile. Matthew quotes the Greek Old Testament, which joins "in the wilderness" to the voice; the Hebrew joins it to "prepare". Either way John fits: he preaches in the wilderness.

decisions.choice: the Lord: God in Isaiah; the one John prepares for is Jesus
alternatives: God alone, with no thought of Jesus
decisions.reason: In Isaiah the Lord is God, whose name stands in the Hebrew. John prepares the way for the one coming after him (3:11), who is Jesus (3:13-17). Matthew lets the words for God's coming describe Jesus's coming.

decisions.choice: this is the one: Matthew's comment, not John's
decisions.reason: "For" introduces the narrator's explanation of who John is.

decisions.choice: his paths (L, R); the roads he will travel (B), with deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: no span, as for a pronoun for God in Isaiah
decisions.reason: The pronoun is for the Lord, whom Matthew identifies with Jesus, so it takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: John (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name John for clarity.

decisions.choice: barabara atakazopita, with no span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced "the roads he will travel" has a span on "he". Swahili carries "he" in the verb prefix of "atakazopita", which cannot take a capital, so Balanced has no span here; Literal and Readable keep it on "yake".

decisions.choice: the quotation of Isaiah 40:3 worded as in the Korean Mark 1:3 at each level
decisions.reason: The Greek of the quotation is the same in both Gospels, so the Korean is too. "그분" and "주님" carry the respect the English deity_pronoun span gives.

decisions.choice: the words of Isaiah 40:3 as in the Vietnamese Mark 1:3
decisions.reason: The Greek of the quotation is the same as in Mark, so the Vietnamese reads alike, as synoptic parallels should; "đồng hoang" (L, B) and "sa mạc" (R) are kept for the wilderness through chapter 4.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for the Lord, for Jesus and for God are written plainly.

source.text: αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.

records.literal_gloss: He then the John had the garment of him from hairs of camel and a belt leathern around the waist of him, the then food was of him locusts and honey wild.

en.L: Now John himself had his clothing of camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.
en.B: John himself dressed in clothing woven from camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
en.R: John wore clothes made from camel hair, with a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts, a kind of grasshopper, and honey that he found in the wild.

es.L: Y Juan mismo tenía su ropa de pelo de camello y un cinturón de cuero en torno a su cintura, y su alimento eran langostas y miel silvestre.
es.B: Juan se vestía con ropa tejida de pelo de camello y llevaba un cinturón de cuero a la cintura; comía langostas y miel silvestre.
es.R: Juan llevaba ropa hecha de pelo de camello, con un cinturón de cuero en la cintura. Comía langostas, que son una especie de saltamontes, y miel que encontraba en el campo.

fr.L: Or Jean lui-même avait son vêtement de poils de chameau et une ceinture de cuir autour de ses reins, et sa nourriture était des sauterelles et du miel sauvage.
fr.B: Jean portait un vêtement tissé de poils de chameau, avec une ceinture de cuir autour de la taille, et il se nourrissait de sauterelles et de miel sauvage.
fr.R: Jean portait des vêtements faits en poils de chameau, avec une ceinture de cuir autour de la taille. Il mangeait des sauterelles et du miel qu’il trouvait dans la nature.

sw.L: Naye Yohana mwenyewe alikuwa na nguo yake ya nywele za ngamia, na mkanda wa ngozi kuzunguka kiuno chake, na chakula alichokula kilikuwa nzige na asali ya porini.
sw.B: Yohana mwenyewe alivaa nguo iliyofumwa kwa nywele za ngamia, akiwa na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni, naye alikula nzige na asali ya porini.
sw.R: Yohana alivaa nguo zilizotengenezwa kwa manyoya ya ngamia, na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni. Alikula nzige, aina ya panzi, na asali aliyoipata porini.

ko.L: 이 요한은 낙타 털로 된 옷을 입고 허리에 가죽 띠를 [둘렀으며], 그의 음식은 메뚜기와 들꿀이었다.
ko.B: 요한은 낙타 털로 짠 옷을 입고 허리에 가죽 띠를 둘렀으며, 메뚜기와 들꿀을 먹었다.
ko.R: 요한은 낙타 털로 만든 옷을 입고, 허리에는 가죽 띠를 매고 있었다. 그는 메뚜기와, 들에서 찾은 꿀을 먹었다.

vi.L: Còn chính Giăng thì mặc áo bằng lông lạc đà và thắt dây lưng bằng da quanh hông, và thức ăn của ông là châu chấu và mật ong rừng.
vi.B: Chính Giăng mặc áo bằng lông lạc đà, thắt lưng bằng dây da, và ông ăn châu chấu với mật ong rừng.
vi.R: Giăng mặc áo làm bằng lông lạc đà, có dây da thắt ngang lưng. Ông ăn châu chấu và mật ong tìm được ngoài hoang dã.

am.L: ዮሐንስም ራሱ የግመል ጠጉር ልብስ ነበረው፤ በወገቡም ዙሪያ የቆዳ ቀበቶ [ነበረው]፤ ምግቡም አንበጣና የዱር ማር ነበረ።
am.B: ዮሐንስ ራሱ ከግመል ጠጉር የተሠራ ልብስ ይለብስ ነበር፤ በወገቡም የቆዳ ቀበቶ ይታጠቅ ነበር፤ አንበጣና የዱር ማርም ይመገብ ነበር።
am.R: ዮሐንስ ከግመል ጠጉር የተሠራ ልብስ ይለብስ ነበር፤ በወገቡም የቆዳ ቀበቶ ያስር ነበር። የሚበላውም አንበጣ ነበረ፤ አንበጣ እንደ ፌንጣ ያለ ነፍሳት ነው። በዱር ያገኘውንም ማር ይበላ ነበር።

decisions.choice: camel's hair and a leather belt: the dress of Elijah
decisions.reason: Elijah was known as a hairy man with a leather belt around his waist (2 Kings 1:8). Malachi promised that Elijah would come before the day of the Lord (Malachi 4:5), and Jesus later says that John is the Elijah who was to come (11:14; 17:12-13).

decisions.choice: locusts and wild honey: food found in the wilderness
decisions.reason: The law allows locusts as food (Leviticus 11:22). Wild honey was taken from wild bees. John lives on what the wilderness provides, apart from towns.

decisions.choice: locusts, a kind of grasshopper
decisions.reason: Readable says what locusts are.

decisions.choice: des sauterelles, with no explanation at Readable
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:6: English Readable explains "locusts" as a kind of grasshopper. French "sauterelle" is already the everyday name of that insect, so Readable needs no gloss.

decisions.choice: "châu chấu" with no explanation (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:6: the English Readable explains "locusts", but "châu chấu" is an everyday Vietnamese word, so no explanation is needed.

source.text: τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Then were going out to him Jerusalem and all the Judea and all the region around the Jordan, \v 6 and were being baptized in the Jordan river by him confessing the sins of them.

en.L: Then Jerusalem and all Judea and all the region around the Jordan were going out to him, \v 6 and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
en.B: Crowds kept coming out to him from Jerusalem, from all over Judea, and from all the country along the Jordan. \v 6 They confessed their sins, and he baptized them in the Jordan River.
en.R: People from Jerusalem, from all over Judea, and from all the land near the Jordan River came out to John. \v 6 They told how they had done wrong, and John baptized them in the Jordan River.

es.L: Entonces salían hacia él Jerusalén y toda Judea y toda la comarca del Jordán, \v 6 y eran bautizados en el río Jordán por él, mientras confesaban sus pecados.
es.B: Venían a él multitudes de Jerusalén, de toda Judea y de toda la región del Jordán. \v 6 Confesaban sus pecados, y él los bautizaba en el río Jordán.
es.R: Gente de Jerusalén, de toda Judea y de toda la tierra cercana al río Jordán salía a ver a Juan. \v 6 Contaban el mal que habían hecho, y Juan los bautizaba en el río Jordán.

fr.L: Alors sortaient vers lui Jérusalem, et toute la Judée, et toute la région autour du Jourdain, \v 6 et ils étaient baptisés par lui dans le fleuve Jourdain, confessant leurs péchés.
fr.B: Des foules venaient à lui sans cesse, de Jérusalem, de toute la Judée et de toute la région qui borde le Jourdain. \v 6 Elles confessaient leurs péchés, et il les baptisait dans le Jourdain.
fr.R: Des gens venaient voir Jean : ils venaient de Jérusalem, de toute la Judée et de toute la région près du fleuve Jourdain. \v 6 Ils disaient le mal qu’ils avaient fait, et Jean les baptisait dans le fleuve Jourdain.

sw.L: Ndipo Yerusalemu na Uyahudi wote na eneo lote linalozunguka Yordani walikuwa wakimwendea, \v 6 nao walikuwa wakibatizwa naye katika mto Yordani, wakiziungama dhambi zao.
sw.B: Umati wa watu uliendelea kumwendea kutoka Yerusalemu, kutoka kila sehemu ya Uyahudi na kutoka nchi yote iliyo kando ya Yordani. \v 6 Wakaungama dhambi zao, naye akawabatiza katika mto Yordani.
sw.R: Watu kutoka Yerusalemu, kutoka Uyahudi kote, na kutoka nchi yote iliyo karibu na mto Yordani walikuja kwa Yohana. \v 6 Walieleza makosa waliyofanya, naye Yohana akawabatiza katika mto Yordani.

ko.L: 그때 예루살렘과 온 유대와 요단 주변의 온 지역이 그에게로 나가고 있었고, \v 6 자기들의 죄를 고백하며 요단강에서 그에게 세례를 받고 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 예루살렘과 온 유대와 요단강 주변 온 지역에서 사람들이 요한에게로 줄지어 나왔다. \v 6 그들은 자기 죄를 고백했고, 요한은 요단강에서 그들에게 세례를 주었다.
ko.R: 예루살렘과 유대 온 지역과 요단강 근처 온 땅에서 사람들이 요한에게 나왔다. \v 6 그들은 자기가 저지른 잘못을 털어놓았고, 요한은 요단강에서 그들에게 세례를 주었다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Giê-ru-sa-lem, cả xứ Giu-đê và cả vùng chung quanh sông Giô-đanh đều kéo ra với ông, \v 6 và họ được ông làm báp-têm trong sông Giô-đanh, xưng tội mình.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân chúng từ Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ khắp xứ Giu-đê và cả vùng dọc theo sông Giô-đanh lũ lượt kéo ra với ông. \v 6 Họ xưng tội mình và được ông làm báp-têm dưới sông Giô-đanh.
vi.R: Người ta từ thành Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ khắp miền Giu-đê và từ cả vùng gần sông Giô-đanh kéo đến với Giăng. \v 6 Họ thú nhận những điều sai trái mình đã làm, và Giăng làm báp-têm cho họ dưới sông Giô-đanh.

am.L: ከዚያም ኢየሩሳሌም፣ ይሁዳ ሁሉ፣ በዮርዳኖስ አካባቢ ያለውም ምድር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጣ ነበር፤ \v 6 በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝም ኃጢአታቸውን እየተናዘዙ በእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።
am.B: ከኢየሩሳሌም፣ ከይሁዳ ሁሉና በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ካለው አገር ሁሉ ብዙ ሕዝብ ወደ እርሱ ይጎርፍ ነበር። \v 6 ኃጢአታቸውንም ይናዘዙ ነበር፤ እርሱም በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ያጠምቃቸው ነበር።
am.R: ከኢየሩሳሌም፣ ከይሁዳ ሁሉና በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አጠገብ ካለው ምድር ሁሉ ሰዎች ወደ ዮሐንስ መጡ። \v 6 ያደረጉትን ክፉ ነገር በግልጥ ተናገሩ፤ ዮሐንስም በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አጠመቃቸው።

decisions.choice: Jerusalem and all Judea: the people of those places, in great numbers
decisions.reason: The places stand for their people, and "all" stresses how many came. The imperfect verbs say they kept coming.

decisions.choice: baptized: dipped or washed in water
decisions.reason: The verb means to dip or immerse. Jews washed in water to become clean for worship. John's washing, given once and joined to confessing sins, marked a turning back to God ahead of the coming judgment.

decisions.choice: confessing their sins: saying openly what they had done wrong
alternatives: admitting sin only in their hearts
decisions.reason: The verb means to acknowledge out loud. They named their sins as they came to be baptized.

decisions.choice: crowds kept coming (B); people ... came (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the people instead of the places.

source.text: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to the baptism of him he said to them, Offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

en.L: But seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, "Offspring of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
en.B: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he said to them, "You family of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming wrath?
en.R: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. When John saw them, he said to them, "You are like a family of poisonous snakes! Who told you that you could escape from God's anger that is coming?

es.L: Pero viendo a muchos de los fariseos y saduceos que venían a su bautismo, les dijo: «¡Crías de víboras! ¿Quién {{plural_you:les|os}} advirtió que {{plural_you:huyeran|huyerais}} de la ira venidera?
es.B: Pero cuando Juan vio que muchos fariseos y saduceos venían a bautizarse, les dijo: «¡Familia de serpientes! ¿Quién {{plural_you:les|os}} advirtió que {{plural_you:huyeran|huyerais}} de la ira que viene?
es.R: Muchos fariseos y saduceos también vinieron para que Juan los bautizara. Cuando Juan los vio, les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} como una familia de serpientes venenosas! ¿Quién {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo que {{plural_you:podían|podíais}} escapar de la ira de Dios que se acerca?

fr.L: Mais voyant beaucoup de Pharisiens et de Sadducéens venir à son baptême, il leur dit : « Progéniture de vipères ! Qui vous a avertis de fuir la colère à venir ?
fr.B: Mais quand Jean vit beaucoup de Pharisiens et de Sadducéens venir se faire baptiser, il leur dit : « Enfants de serpents ! Qui vous a avertis de fuir la colère qui vient ?
fr.R: Beaucoup de Pharisiens et de Sadducéens sont venus, eux aussi, pour se faire baptiser. Quand Jean les a vus, il leur a dit : « Vous êtes comme une famille de serpents venimeux ! Qui vous a dit que vous pourriez échapper à la colère de Dieu qui va venir ?

sw.L: Lakini akiisha kuona wengi wa Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wakija kwa ajili ya ubatizo wake, alisema nao, "Ninyi uzao wa nyoka wenye sumu! Nani amewaelekeza kukimbia mbali na ghadhabu ijayo?
sw.B: Lakini Yohana alipowaona Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wengi wakija kubatizwa, aliwaambia, "Ninyi jamaa ya nyoka! Ni nani aliyewaonya mkimbie ghadhabu inayokuja?
sw.R: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wengi pia walikuja ili wabatizwe. Yohana alipowaona, aliwaambia, "Ninyi ni kama jamaa ya nyoka wenye sumu! Ni nani aliyewaambia kwamba mnaweza kuiepuka hasira ya Mungu inayokuja?

ko.L: 그러나 그는 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들 가운데 많은 이가 자기의 세례에 오는 것을 보고 그들에게 말하였다. "독사들의 자식들아, 누가 너희에게 다가올 진노를 피하라고 일러 주었느냐?
ko.B: 요한은 많은 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들이 세례를 받으러 오는 것을 보고 그들에게 말했다. "독사의 족속들아! 다가오는 진노를 피하라고 누가 너희에게 일러 주더냐?
ko.R: 바리새파 사람들과 사두개파 사람들도 많이 세례를 받으러 왔다. 요한은 그들을 보고 말했다. "너희는 독 있는 뱀의 무리와 같다! 곧 닥쳐올 하나님의 진노를 피할 수 있다고 누가 너희에게 말해 주더냐?

vi.L: Nhưng thấy nhiều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến [chịu] phép báp-têm của mình, ông nói với họ: "Hỡi dòng giống rắn lục! Ai đã chỉ cho các người trốn khỏi cơn thịnh nộ sắp đến?
vi.B: Nhưng khi Giăng thấy nhiều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến để chịu báp-têm, ông nói với họ: "Hỡi nòi rắn độc! Ai đã cảnh báo các người trốn khỏi cơn thịnh nộ sắp đến?
vi.R: Cũng có nhiều người Pha-ri-si và Sa-đu-sê đến để chịu báp-têm. Khi Giăng thấy họ, ông nói với họ: "Các người như một bầy rắn độc! Ai bảo các người rằng các người có thể thoát khỏi cơn giận của Đức Chúa Trời sắp đến?

am.L: ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያንም ብዙዎች ወደ ጥምቀቱ ሲመጡ አይቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «የእፉኝት ዘሮች! ከሚመጣው ቁጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አሳያችሁ?
am.B: ዮሐንስ ግን ብዙ ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያን ለመጠመቅ ሲመጡ ባየ ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እናንተ የእባብ ዘሮች! ከሚመጣው ቁጣ እንድታመልጡ ማን አስጠነቀቃችሁ?
am.R: ብዙ ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያንም ለመጠመቅ መጡ። ዮሐንስ ባያቸው ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እናንተ እንደ መርዛም እባብ ዘሮች ናችሁ! ከሚመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ ማምለጥ እንደምትችሉ ማን ነገራችሁ?

decisions.choice: Pharisees and Sadducees: two leading groups among the Jews
decisions.reason: The Pharisees were teachers and lay people devoted to keeping the law in detail. The Sadducees were mostly priests and wealthy families tied to the temple. The two groups often disagreed; Matthew names them together as Israel's leaders (16:1, 6).

decisions.choice: coming to his baptism: coming to be baptized
alternatives: coming to watch where he baptized
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean coming for baptism or coming to the place of baptism. John's answer, which questions why they would flee and asks for fruit, fits people who came to be baptized.

decisions.choice: offspring of vipers: people as dangerous and false as poisonous snakes
decisions.reason: Calling people children of something describes their nature. Jesus uses the same words for the Pharisees (12:34; 23:33).

decisions.choice: the coming wrath: God's judgment that is about to fall
decisions.reason: Wrath here is God's anger against sin at the judgment (1 Thessalonians 1:10). John sees it as near (3:10, 12).

decisions.choice: John
decisions.reason: A new paragraph begins here, so Balanced names John.

decisions.choice: you family of snakes (B); you are like a family of poisonous snakes (R)
decisions.reason: "Brood" and "viper" are less common words today. Readable makes the comparison plain.

decisions.choice: God's anger
decisions.reason: Readable says whose anger it is.

decisions.choice: Crías de víboras
decisions.reason: The Greek word is offspring, the young of an animal (meaning decision m3). "Crías" says that plainly; Balanced and Readable speak of a family of snakes, as the English does.

decisions.choice: les Pharisiens, les Sadducéens, capitalised (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet, John, Mark and Luke: the names of the groups take a capital, as in English.

decisions.choice: Progéniture de vipères (L); Enfants de serpents (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "offspring". "Race de vipères" is the traditional wording, but "race" now sounds like ethnicity; Balanced says "Enfants de serpents", as Luke 3:7 and Matthew 12:34 do, which keeps the insult of the family picture (m3).

decisions.choice: "독사들의 자식들아" (L); "독사의 족속들아" (B); "너희는 독 있는 뱀의 무리와 같다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture word for word; Balanced uses "족속" (a breed or brood), as the English "family of snakes"; Readable turns the picture into a comparison (meaning decision on the idiom). John speaks in 해라체, as a prophet rebuking.

decisions.choice: "dòng giống rắn lục" (L); "nòi rắn độc" (B); "như một bầy rắn độc" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "offspring" and the kind of snake; Balanced uses "nòi", a sharp word for breed that keeps the insult; Readable makes the comparison plain, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: John speaks to the Pharisees and Sadducees as "các người"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:8: a prophet rebuking a crowd uses "các người", which is firm without being insulting in itself.

source.text: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.

records.literal_gloss: Produce therefore fruit worthy of the repentance \v 9 and not think to say among yourselves, [As] father we have the Abraham, I say for to you that is able the God out of the stones these to raise up children to the Abraham.

en.L: Produce therefore fruit worthy of repentance, \v 9 and do not presume to say among yourselves, 'We have Abraham [as] father,' for I tell you that God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.
en.B: So produce fruit that shows your repentance is real. \v 9 Do not imagine you can comfort yourselves by saying, 'Abraham is our father.' I tell you, God is able to make children for Abraham out of these stones.
en.R: Show by the way you live that you have really turned away from your sins. \v 9 Do not think, 'We are safe, because Abraham is our ancestor.' I tell you, God could make children for Abraham out of these stones.

es.L: {{plural_you:Produzcan|Producid}}, pues, fruto digno del arrepentimiento, \v 9 y no {{plural_you:presuman|presumáis}} de decir entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: “Tenemos a Abraham [por] padre”, porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que Dios es capaz de levantar de estas piedras hijos para Abraham.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:den|dad}} fruto que muestre que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} arrepentimiento es verdadero. \v 9 No {{plural_you:se imaginen|os imaginéis}} que {{plural_you:pueden tranquilizarse|podéis tranquilizaros}} diciendo: “Abraham es nuestro padre”. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que Dios puede sacar hijos para Abraham de estas piedras.
es.R: {{plural_you:Muestren|Mostrad}} con {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} manera de vivir que de verdad {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados. \v 9 No {{plural_you:piensen|penséis}}: “Estamos a salvo, porque Abraham es nuestro antepasado”. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que Dios podría hacer hijos para Abraham de estas piedras.

fr.L: Produisez donc du fruit digne de la repentance, \v 9 et ne pensez pas pouvoir dire en vous-mêmes : “Nous avons Abraham [pour] père”, car je vous dis que Dieu peut, de ces pierres, susciter des enfants à Abraham.
fr.B: Produisez donc un fruit qui montre que votre repentance est sincère. \v 9 Et n’allez pas vous rassurer en vous disant : “Abraham est notre père.” Car je vous le dis, de ces pierres que voici, Dieu peut faire naître des enfants à Abraham.
fr.R: Montrez par votre façon de vivre que vous vous êtes vraiment détournés de vos péchés. \v 9 Ne pensez pas : “Nous ne risquons rien, parce qu’Abraham est notre ancêtre.” Je vous le dis, Dieu pourrait faire de ces pierres des enfants pour Abraham.

sw.L: Basi toeni matunda yanayolingana na toba, \v 9 wala msidhani kusema ndani yenu, 'Tunaye Ibrahimu [kama] baba,' kwa maana nawaambia kwamba Mungu ana uwezo wa kumwinulia Ibrahimu watoto kutoka katika mawe haya.
sw.B: Basi zaeni matunda yanayoonyesha kwamba toba yenu ni ya kweli. \v 9 Msidhani mnaweza kujifariji kwa kusema, 'Ibrahimu ni baba yetu.' Nawaambia, Mungu anaweza kumfanyia Ibrahimu watoto kutoka katika mawe haya.
sw.R: Onyesheni kwa jinsi mnavyoishi kwamba kweli mmeacha dhambi zenu. \v 9 Msifikiri, 'Sisi tuko salama, kwa sababu Ibrahimu ni babu yetu.' Nawaambia, Mungu angeweza kumfanyia Ibrahimu watoto kutoka katika mawe haya.

ko.L: 그러므로 회개에 합당한 열매를 맺어라. \v 9 그리고 너희 속으로 '우리에게는 아버지 아브라함이 있다'라고 말할 생각을 하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께서는 이 돌들로도 아브라함에게 자녀들을 일으키실 수 있다.
ko.B: 그러니 회개했다는 것을 보여 주는 열매를 맺어라. \v 9 그리고 '우리 조상은 아브라함이다'라고 속으로 말하며 안심할 생각은 하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께서는 이 돌들로도 아브라함의 자녀를 만드실 수 있다.
ko.R: 너희가 정말로 죄에서 돌이켰다면, 그것을 사는 모습으로 보여라. \v 9 '우리는 아브라함의 자손이니까 괜찮다'라고 생각하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께서는 이 돌들로도 아브라함의 자손을 만드실 수 있다.

vi.L: Vậy hãy kết quả xứng đáng với sự ăn năn, \v 9 và đừng tưởng [có thể] nói trong lòng rằng: 'Chúng ta có Áp-ra-ham là tổ phụ,' vì tôi nói với các người rằng Đức Chúa Trời có thể từ những hòn đá này dấy lên con cái cho Áp-ra-ham.
vi.B: Vậy hãy kết quả để chứng tỏ sự ăn năn của các người là thật. \v 9 Đừng tưởng có thể tự yên lòng mà nói: 'Áp-ra-ham là tổ phụ chúng ta.' Vì tôi nói cho các người biết, Đức Chúa Trời có thể biến những hòn đá này thành con cháu cho Áp-ra-ham.
vi.R: Hãy sống sao cho thấy các người thật sự đã từ bỏ tội lỗi. \v 9 Đừng nghĩ rằng: 'Chúng ta được an toàn, vì Áp-ra-ham là tổ tiên chúng ta.' Tôi nói cho các người biết, Đức Chúa Trời có thể biến những hòn đá này thành con cháu của Áp-ra-ham.

am.L: ስለዚህ ለንስሓ የሚመጥን ፍሬ አፍሩ፤ \v 9 በራሳችሁም “አባት አብርሃም አለን” ለማለት አታስቡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ማስነሣት እንደሚችል እነግራችኋለሁና።
am.B: ስለዚህ ንስሓችሁ እውነተኛ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ፍሬ አፍሩ። \v 9 “አባታችን አብርሃም ነው” እያላችሁ ራሳችሁን ለማጽናናት አታስቡ። እላችኋለሁ፣ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ማስገኘት ይችላል።
am.R: ከኃጢአታችሁ በእውነት መመለሳችሁን በአኗኗራችሁ አሳዩ። \v 9 “አብርሃም ቅድመ አያታችን ስለ ሆነ ምንም አያስፈራንም” ብላችሁ አታስቡ። እነግራችኋለሁ፣ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ሊያስገኝ ይችላል።

decisions.choice: fruit worthy of repentance: deeds that match a changed life
decisions.reason: Fruit is a picture of what a life produces. John asks for a changed life to show itself in deeds (7:16-20).

decisions.choice: We have Abraham as father: trust that belonging to Abraham's family is enough
decisions.reason: God's promises to Abraham and his descendants (Genesis 17:7) could be taken as a guarantee for every descendant. John says descent does not take the place of repentance.

decisions.choice: from these stones children: perhaps a play on words
decisions.reason: In Hebrew and Aramaic the words for "stones" and "sons" sound alike. If John spoke Aramaic, his hearers may have heard the play. Isaiah 51:1-2 also calls Abraham the rock from which Israel was cut.

decisions.choice: fruit that shows your repentance is real (B); show by the way you live (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture and says what it shows; Readable states the meaning.

decisions.choice: We are safe, because Abraham is our ancestor
alternatives: We have Abraham as our father
decisions.reason: Readable states what the saying was meant to claim.

decisions.choice: "kết quả" (L, B) for producing fruit
decisions.reason: "Kết quả" means both to bear fruit and a result, so it keeps the picture and its sense; 3:10 says "trái" for the fruit of the tree, the same Greek word.

source.text: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

records.literal_gloss: Already then the ax at the root of the trees lies; every therefore tree not producing fruit good is cut down and into fire is thrown.

en.L: And already the ax lies at the root of the trees; so every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and thrown into [the] fire.
en.B: The ax is already set against the root of the trees. Any tree that fails to bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
en.R: The ax is ready at the roots of the trees. God's judgment is that close. Every tree that does not grow good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

es.L: Ya el hacha yace junto a la raíz de los árboles; así que todo árbol que no da fruto bueno se corta y se echa al fuego.
es.B: El hacha ya está colocada junto a la raíz de los árboles. Cualquier árbol que no dé buen fruto se corta y se arroja al fuego.
es.R: El hacha está lista junto a las raíces de los árboles. El juicio de Dios está así de cerca. Todo árbol que no dé buen fruto será cortado y echado al fuego.

fr.L: Et déjà la hache est placée à la racine des arbres ; tout arbre donc qui ne produit pas de bon fruit est coupé et jeté au feu.
fr.B: La hache est déjà posée contre la racine des arbres. Tout arbre qui ne porte pas de bon fruit, on l’abat et on le jette au feu.
fr.R: La hache est prête, au pied des arbres. Le jugement de Dieu est aussi proche que cela. Tout arbre qui ne donne pas de bons fruits sera coupé et jeté dans le feu.

sw.L: Tayari shoka lipo kwenye mzizi wa miti; kwa hiyo kila mti ambao hauzai tunda zuri unakatwa na kutupwa katika moto.
sw.B: Shoka limekwisha kuwekwa kwenye mizizi ya miti. Mti wowote usiozaa matunda mazuri unakatwa na kutupwa motoni.
sw.R: Shoka liko tayari kwenye mizizi ya miti. Hukumu ya Mungu iko karibu hivyo. Kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri utakatwa na kutupwa motoni.

ko.L: 이미 도끼가 나무들의 뿌리에 놓여 있다. 그러므로 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 찍혀서 불 속에 던져진다.
ko.B: 도끼가 벌써 나무뿌리에 닿아 있다. 좋은 열매를 맺지 못하는 나무는 어느 것이나 베어져 불에 던져진다.
ko.R: 나무뿌리에 도끼가 벌써 놓여 있다. 하나님의 심판이 그만큼 가까이 왔다. 좋은 열매를 맺지 않는 나무는 모두 베어져 불 속에 던져질 것이다.

vi.L: Và cái rìu đã đặt sẵn nơi rễ cây; vậy mọi cây không sinh trái tốt đều bị đốn và ném vào lửa.
vi.B: Cái rìu đã kề sẵn gốc cây. Cây nào không sinh trái tốt sẽ bị đốn đi và ném vào lửa.
vi.R: Cái rìu đã sẵn sàng bên gốc cây. Sự phán xét của Đức Chúa Trời đã gần đến như vậy. Cây nào không sinh trái tốt sẽ bị chặt đi và ném vào lửa.

am.L: መጥረቢያውም ከአሁኑ በዛፎቹ ሥር ተቀምጧል፤ ስለዚህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል፤ ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።
am.B: መጥረቢያው አሁን እንኳ በዛፎቹ ሥር ላይ ተደግኗል። መልካም ፍሬ የማይሰጥ ዛፍ ሁሉ ተቆርጦ ወደ እሳት ይጣላል።
am.R: መጥረቢያው ዛፎቹን ከሥራቸው ለመቁረጥ ተዘጋጅቷል። የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ ያን ያህል ቀርቧል። መልካም ፍሬ የማያፈራ ዛፍ ሁሉ ተቆርጦ ወደ እሳት ይጣላል።

decisions.choice: the ax at the root: judgment is about to fall
decisions.reason: The ax is laid at the root, ready for the first stroke. The trees are the people; the fire is God's judgment (3:12; 7:19).

decisions.choice: is cut down, is thrown: certain, and as good as happening
alternatives: a general rule with no reference to time
decisions.reason: The present tense speaks of what will surely happen as if it were already under way.

decisions.choice: God's judgment is that close
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture and says what it means.

source.text: Ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν· ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·

records.literal_gloss: I indeed you baptize in water for repentance; the but after me coming stronger than me is, of whom not I am fit the sandals to carry; he you will baptize in Spirit Holy and fire;

en.L: I baptize you in water for repentance, but the one coming after me is stronger than I, whose sandals I am not fit to carry; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will baptize you in [the] Holy Spirit and fire.
en.B: I baptize you with water for repentance. But one who comes after me is mightier than I am, and I am not fit even to carry {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
en.R: I baptize you with water to show that you have turned away from your sins. But someone is coming after me who is much greater than I am. I am not good enough even to carry {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

es.L: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizo en agua para arrepentimiento, pero el que viene después de mí es más fuerte que yo, cuyas sandalias no soy apto para cargar; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará en [el] Espíritu Santo y fuego.
es.B: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizo con agua para arrepentimiento. Pero el que viene después de mí es más poderoso que yo, y yo no soy digno ni siquiera de llevar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sandalias. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará con el Espíritu Santo y con fuego.
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizo con agua para mostrar que {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados. Pero viene después de mí alguien mucho más grande que yo. Yo no merezco ni siquiera llevar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sandalias. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará con el Espíritu Santo y con fuego.

fr.L: Moi, je vous baptise dans l’eau en vue de la repentance ; mais celui qui vient après moi est plus fort que moi, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dont je ne suis pas apte à porter les sandales ; {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous baptisera dans l’Esprit Saint et le feu.
fr.B: Moi, je vous baptise avec de l’eau, en vue de la repentance. Mais celui qui vient après moi est plus puissant que moi, et je ne suis même pas digne de porter {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sandales. Lui vous baptisera avec l’Esprit Saint et avec le feu.
fr.R: Moi, je vous baptise avec de l’eau pour montrer que vous vous êtes détournés de vos péchés. Mais quelqu’un vient après moi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est beaucoup plus grand que moi. Je ne suis même pas assez bon pour porter {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sandales. Lui vous baptisera avec l’Esprit Saint et avec le feu.

sw.L: Mimi nawabatiza ninyi katika maji kwa ajili ya toba; lakini anayekuja baada yangu ana nguvu kuliko mimi, ambaye mimi sifai kuzibeba ndara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawabatiza ninyi katika Roho Mtakatifu na moto.
sw.B: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji kwa ajili ya toba. Lakini yule anayekuja baada yangu ana nguvu kuliko mimi, nami sifai hata kubeba ndara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.
sw.R: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji kuonyesha kwamba mmeacha dhambi zenu. Lakini anakuja mtu baada yangu aliye mkuu sana kuliko mimi. Mimi sistahili hata kubeba ndara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.

ko.L: 나는 회개를 위하여 너희에게 물로 세례를 준다. 그러나 내 뒤에 오시는 분은 나보다 더 강하시다. 나는 그분의 신발을 들고 다닐 자격도 없다. 그분은 너희에게 성령과 불로 세례를 주실 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 너희가 회개하도록 물로 세례를 준다. 그러나 내 뒤에 오시는 분은 나보다 더 능력이 있으시다. 나는 그분의 신발을 들어 드릴 자격조차 없다. 그분은 성령과 불로 너희에게 세례를 주실 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 너희가 죄에서 돌이켰다는 표시로 물로 세례를 준다. 그러나 내 뒤에 오시는 분은 나보다 훨씬 더 크신 분이다. 나는 그분의 신발을 들어 드릴 만한 사람도 못 된다. 그분은 성령과 불로 너희에게 세례를 주실 것이다.

vi.L: Tôi làm báp-têm cho các người trong nước để ăn năn, nhưng Đấng đến sau tôi có quyền năng hơn tôi, tôi không xứng đáng xách dép cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người trong Đức Thánh Linh và lửa.
vi.B: Tôi làm báp-têm cho các người bằng nước để ăn năn. Nhưng Đấng đến sau tôi có quyền năng hơn tôi, và tôi không đáng xách dép cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người bằng Đức Thánh Linh và bằng lửa.
vi.R: Tôi dùng nước để làm báp-têm cho các người, để cho thấy các người đã từ bỏ tội lỗi. Nhưng có một Đấng sẽ đến sau tôi, lớn hơn tôi rất nhiều. Tôi không xứng đáng ngay cả xách dép cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người bằng Đức Thánh Linh và bằng lửa.

am.L: እኔ ለንስሓ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ግን ከእኔ የበረታ ነው፤ ጫማውን ለመሸከም እንኳ ብቁ አይደለሁም፤ እርሱ ራሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል።
am.B: እኔ ለንስሓ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ። ነገር ግን ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ከእኔ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ኃያል ነው፤ እኔ ጫማውን እንኳ ለመሸከም አልበቃም። እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል።
am.R: እኔ በውኃ የማጠምቃችሁ ከኃጢአታችሁ መመለሳችሁን ለማሳየት ነው። ነገር ግን ከእኔ እጅግ የሚበልጥ አንድ ሰው ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል። እኔ ጫማውን እንኳ ለመሸከም የሚገባኝ ሰው አይደለሁም። እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል።

decisions.choice: for repentance: a baptism that goes with turning back to God
alternatives: a baptism that brings about repentance
a baptism because they had repented
decisions.reason: The phrase says only that John's baptism has to do with repentance. It may call people to repent or mark their repenting; John's demand for fruit (3:8) suggests both.

decisions.choice: the one coming after me: the Messiah, whom John does not name
decisions.reason: John speaks of someone greater who will come after him. The next scene shows that it is Jesus (3:13-17).

decisions.choice: carry his sandals: the task of the lowest slave
decisions.reason: Carrying or untying a master's sandals was a slave's job. John says he is not worthy even of that.

decisions.choice: with the Holy Spirit and fire: the Spirit for those who repent, fire as judgment
alternatives: the Spirit and fire as one cleansing gift
fire as the Spirit's power only
decisions.reason: "You" has one verb and one preposition for both, so the baptism is one act. In the verses before and after, fire is judgment (3:10, 12), and the wheat and the chaff are two groups. Others read the fire as the Spirit's cleansing (Malachi 3:2-3).

decisions.choice: in water, in the Holy Spirit (L); with water, with the Holy Spirit (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek preposition can mean "in" or "with". Literal keeps "in", the picture of being immersed; Balanced and Readable use the usual English "with".

decisions.choice: to show that you have turned away from your sins
decisions.reason: Readable gives one of the senses the meaning note describes; the note says the phrase may also be a call to repent.

decisions.choice: apte (L); digne (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:7: the word means fit for a task. Literal keeps that sense with "apte"; "je ne suis pas digne de" is the natural French way to say one is not fit even for the lowest service (m3).

decisions.choice: ndara
decisions.reason: "Viatu" is footwear in general and now suggests shoes; "ndara" are open sandals tied to the foot, as the Greek word means. Carrying them was a slave's task (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: John speaks of the one coming with the honorific ("오시는 분", "그분", "주실 것이다")
decisions.reason: John knows the one coming is greater than he is; Korean shows it with -시- and "분", as in the Korean Mark 1:7-8.

decisions.choice: "Đấng" for the one coming
decisions.reason: John speaks of the Messiah without naming him; "Đấng" is the honouring word for a person, as in Mark 1:7, and makes the comparison with John himself clear.

records.literal_gloss: Of whom the winnowing fork in the hand of him, and he will clear out the threshing floor of him and will gather the wheat of him into the barn, the but chaff he will burn up with fire unquenchable.

en.L: His winnowing fork [is] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will clear out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} threshing floor and gather {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wheat into the barn, but the chaff {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn up with unquenchable fire."
en.B: He has {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} winnowing fork in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will clear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} threshing floor. He will gather {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wheat into the barn, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn up the chaff with a fire that cannot be put out."
en.R: He is like a farmer who is ready to separate wheat from chaff. He has the tool for it in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. He will clean {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} threshing floor and put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wheat in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} barn. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn the chaff in a fire that never goes out."

es.L: Su horquilla de aventar [está] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano, y limpiará a fondo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} era, y juntará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trigo en el granero, pero la paja la consumirá con fuego inextinguible».
es.B: Ya tiene en la mano {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} horquilla de aventar, y limpiará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} era. Recogerá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trigo en el granero, pero quemará la paja en un fuego que nadie puede apagar».
es.R: Él es como un campesino que está listo para separar el trigo de la paja. Tiene en la mano la herramienta para hacerlo. Limpiará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} era y guardará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trigo en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} granero. Pero quemará la paja en un fuego que nunca se apaga».

fr.B: Il tient en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} pelle à vanner, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va nettoyer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} aire. Il amassera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} blé dans le grenier, mais la paille, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la brûlera dans un feu qui ne s’éteint jamais. »

Il va nettoyer l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bat le blé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} blé dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grenier. Mais la paille, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la brûlera dans un feu qui ne s’éteint jamais. »

ko.L: 그분의 손에 넉가래가 [들려] 있다. 그리고 그분은 자기 타작마당을 깨끗이 하시고, 자기 밀을 곳간에 모아들이시고, 쭉정이는 꺼지지 않는 불로 태워 버리실 것이다."
ko.B: 그분은 손에 넉가래를 들고 계신다. 그분은 타작마당을 깨끗이 하셔서, 밀은 곳간에 모아들이시고, 쭉정이는 꺼지지 않는 불에 태워 버리실 것이다."
ko.R: 그분은 밀과 쭉정이를 가르려고 준비하고 있는 농부와 같다. 그분은 그 일을 할 넉가래를 손에 들고 계신다. 그분은 타작마당을 깨끗이 하시고, 밀은 곳간에 모아들이실 것이다. 그러나 쭉정이는 결코 꺼지지 않는 불에 태워 버리실 것이다."

vi.L: Cái nia [ở] trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dọn sạch sân đập lúa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và thu lúa mì của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào kho, còn trấu thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đốt trong lửa không hề tắt."

vi.R: Ngài giống như một người nông dân sẵn sàng tách lúa mì ra khỏi trấu. Ngài đã cầm sẵn dụng cụ trong tay. Ngài sẽ dọn sạch sân đập lúa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đem lúa mì cất vào kho. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đốt trấu trong lửa không bao giờ tắt."
