decisions.choice: winnowing fork, threshing floor, chaff: the work of separating grain at harvest
decisions.reason: After threshing, a farmer tossed the grain into the wind with a wooden fork on a hard, open floor. The wind carried off the light chaff and the grain fell back. The grain was stored, and the chaff was burned.

decisions.choice: the one coming will separate people at the judgment
alternatives: a picture of everyday life only
decisions.reason: The wheat and the chaff are the people who repent and those who do not, as with the good and bad trees of 3:10. Jesus uses the same kind of picture in 13:30.

decisions.choice: unquenchable fire: fire that no one can put out
alternatives: fire that burns for a short time
decisions.reason: The fire of judgment cannot be stopped (Isaiah 66:24; Mark 9:43, 48).

decisions.choice: whose: the relative ties this to 3:11, the one who is coming
decisions.reason: The verse begins with "whose", so it goes on speaking of the one coming after John.

decisions.choice: His winnowing fork (L); He has his winnowing fork (B); He is like a farmer (R)
decisions.reason: English does not begin a new sentence with "whose", so the levels begin with "his" or "he". Readable says the farmer is a comparison.

decisions.choice: horquilla de aventar
decisions.reason: The tool is a wooden fork for tossing threshed grain into the wind (meaning decision m1). "Aventador" and "bieldo" are not known everywhere; "horquilla de aventar" says what it is.

decisions.choice: la balle (L); la paille (B, R)
decisions.reason: "La balle" is the exact French word for the husks blown off the grain, but most readers today know it only as "ball". Balanced and Readable say "la paille", the everyday word for what is left once the grain is taken (m1).

decisions.choice: chombo cha kupepetea
decisions.reason: A "pepeto" is the flat tray used to winnow by shaking; the Greek tool is a fork for tossing grain into the wind (meaning decision m1). "Chombo cha kupepetea" (winnowing tool) names its use without the wrong picture.

decisions.choice: "넉가래" for the winnowing fork; "쭉정이" for the chaff
decisions.reason: The Greek tool is a wooden shovel or fork used to toss threshed grain into the wind; "넉가래" is the Korean wooden shovel used for the same work. "키" is a winnowing basket, a different tool. "쭉정이" is the empty husk that blows away, the plain word for what is worthless.

decisions.choice: "nia", "sân đập lúa", "trấu" for winnowing fork, threshing floor and chaff
decisions.reason: The Greek tool is a fork or shovel for tossing grain in the wind; Vietnamese farmers winnow with a "nia" (a flat tray), which does the same work and which every reader can picture. "Trấu" is the husk separated from the grain. Readable says "dụng cụ" (tool), as the English Readable does.

source.text: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Then comes the Jesus from the Galilee to the Jordan to the John to be baptized by him.

en.L: Then Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.
en.B: Then Jesus arrived from Galilee and came to John at the Jordan, to be baptized by him.
en.R: Then Jesus traveled from Galilee to the Jordan River. He came to John so that John would baptize {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Entonces viene Jesús desde Galilea al Jordán, a Juan, para ser bautizado por él.
es.B: Entonces Jesús llegó de Galilea al Jordán, adonde estaba Juan, para ser bautizado por él.
es.R: Entonces Jesús viajó desde Galilea hasta el río Jordán. Fue a ver a Juan para que Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} bautizara.

fr.L: Alors Jésus arrive de Galilée au Jourdain, auprès de Jean, pour être baptisé par lui.
fr.B: Alors Jésus vint de Galilée au Jourdain, auprès de Jean, pour se faire baptiser par lui.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus est venu de Galilée jusqu’au fleuve Jourdain. Il est allé voir Jean pour que Jean {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} baptise.

sw.L: Ndipo Yesu anawasili kutoka Galilaya kwenye Yordani, kwa Yohana, ili kubatizwa naye.
sw.B: Kisha Yesu alifika kutoka Galilaya, akamwendea Yohana huko Yordani ili abatizwe naye.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alisafiri kutoka Galilaya mpaka mto Yordani. Alimwendea Yohana ili Yohana ambatize.

ko.L: 그때 예수께서 갈릴리에서 요단으로 요한에게 오신다. 그에게 세례를 받으시려는 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 예수께서 요한에게 세례를 받으시려고 갈릴리에서 요단강으로 요한을 찾아오셨다.
ko.R: 그때 예수께서 갈릴리에서 요단강으로 가셨다. 요한에게 세례를 받으시려고 요한을 찾아가신 것이다.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê đến sông Giô-đanh, gặp Giăng để được ông làm báp-têm.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê đến với Giăng tại sông Giô-đanh để chịu báp-têm.
vi.R: Lúc ấy, Đức Giê-xu từ miền Ga-li-lê đi đến sông Giô-đanh. Ngài đến gặp Giăng để Giăng làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በእርሱ ለመጠመቅ ከገሊላ [ተነሥቶ] ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ወደ ዮሐንስ ይመጣል።
am.B: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጥቶ በዮሐንስ ለመጠመቅ ወደ እርሱ ቀረበ።
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ተጓዘ። ዮሐንስ እንዲያጠምቀው ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

decisions.choice: to be baptized: Jesus comes for this purpose
decisions.reason: The verb form states his purpose. Jesus seeks baptism; John's protest follows.

decisions.choice: comes (L); came, arrived (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration; Balanced and Readable use the past.

decisions.choice: viene (L); llegó (B); viajó (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:13 and the English: Matthew uses the present tense here and in 3:1 and 3:15. Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (anawasili, and anajitokeza in 3:1); past at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As in 2:13: Matthew uses the present tense here and in 3:1 and 3:15. Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the narrative past.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων· Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με;

records.literal_gloss: The but John was preventing him saying, I need by you to be baptized, and you come to me?

en.L: But John tried to prevent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "I need to be baptized by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come to me?"
en.B: John tried to stop {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. "I am the one who needs to be baptized by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}," he said, "and yet {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come to me?"
en.R: But John tried to talk {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out of it. He said, "I should be baptized by {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! Why are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} coming to me?"

es.L: Pero Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} intentaba detener, diciendo: «Yo tengo necesidad de ser bautizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, ¿y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vienes a mí?».
es.B: Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} quiso detener. «Soy yo quien necesita que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me bautices», dijo, «¿y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vienes a mí?».
es.R: Pero Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} quería convencer de que no se bautizara. Le dijo: «¡Yo debería ser bautizado por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}! ¿Por qué vienes {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a mí?».

fr.L: Mais Jean cherchait à {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}en empêcher, disant : « Moi, j’ai besoin d’être baptisé par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viens à moi ? »
fr.B: Jean tenta de {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}en dissuader : « C’est moi qui ai besoin d’être baptisé par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, dit-il, et c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui viens à moi ? »
fr.R: Mais Jean a essayé de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire changer d’avis. Il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a dit : « C’est moi qui devrais être baptisé par {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! Pourquoi est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viens vers moi ? »

sw.L: Lakini Yohana aliendelea kumzuia, akisema, "Mimi nina haja ya kubatizwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unakuja kwangu?"
sw.B: Yohana alijaribu kumzuia. "Mimi ndiye ninayehitaji kubatizwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}," akasema, "lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unakuja kwangu?"
sw.R: Lakini Yohana alijaribu kumshawishi asibatizwe. Akasema, "Ningepaswa mimi kubatizwa na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}! Mbona {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unakuja kwangu?"

ko.L: 그러나 요한은 그분을 말리며 말하였다. "제가 선생님께 세례를 받아야 하는데, 선생님께서 제게 오십니까?"
ko.B: 요한이 그분을 말리며 말했다. "오히려 제가 선생님께 세례를 받아야 할 사람인데, 선생님께서 저에게 오시다니요?"
ko.R: 그러나 요한은 예수를 말리려고 했다. 요한이 말했다. "제가 선생님께 세례를 받아야 합니다! 그런데 왜 선생님께서 저에게 오십니까?"

vi.L: Nhưng Giăng cố ngăn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nói rằng: "Chính tôi cần được Thầy làm báp-têm, mà Thầy lại đến với tôi sao?"
vi.B: Nhưng Giăng cố can ngăn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Chính tôi mới cần được Thầy làm báp-têm, thế mà Thầy lại đến với tôi sao?"
vi.R: Nhưng Giăng cố thuyết phục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đừng làm vậy. Ông nói: "Tôi mới cần được Thầy làm báp-têm! Sao Thầy lại đến với tôi?"

am.L: ዮሐንስ ግን እንዲህ እያለ ሊከለክለው ሞከረ፦ «እኔ በአንተ መጠመቅ ያስፈልገኛል፤ አንተስ ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህ?»
am.B: ዮሐንስ ግን ሊያግደው ሞከረ። «በአንተ መጠመቅ የሚያስፈልገኝ እኔ ነኝ» አለው፤ «ታዲያ አንተ ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህ?»
am.R: ዮሐንስ ግን ሐሳቡን ሊያስለውጠው ሞከረ። እንዲህም አለው፦ «እኔ ነኝ በአንተ መጠመቅ ያለብኝ! ለምን ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህ?»

decisions.choice: tried to prevent: he kept trying to stop him
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense describes an attempt, which Jesus overcomes (3:15).

decisions.choice: I ... you: John sets himself below Jesus
decisions.reason: Both pronouns are written out for emphasis. John has said he is not fit to carry the sandals of the one who comes (3:11).

decisions.choice: John speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "저/제", and "선생님" for "you"
decisions.reason: People speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 (docs/korean-style.md section 4); John sets himself below Jesus (meaning decision), so he uses the humble "저". Korean needs a respectful word for "you"; "당신" would be cold or quarrelsome, and "주님" would say more than John says here, so "선생님" is used, as people address Jesus in the Korean Mark.

decisions.choice: John calls Jesus "Thầy" for "you", with no setting span, and himself "tôi"
decisions.reason: John puts himself below Jesus; "Thầy" (Teacher) is the respectful noun of address the style guide gives to those who honour him, and nouns of address take no deity_pronoun span.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἄφες ἄρτι, οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην.

records.literal_gloss: Answering then the Jesus said to him, Permit now, thus for fitting it is to us to fulfill all righteousness.

en.L: But answering, Jesus said to him, "Permit [it] now, for in this way it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness."
en.B: But Jesus answered, "Allow it for now. This is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness."
en.R: Jesus answered, "Let it happen this way for now. We should do everything that is righteous in God's eyes, and this is part of it."

es.L: Pero respondiendo, Jesús le dijo: «Permite [esto] ahora, porque de esta manera nos es apropiado cumplir toda justicia».
es.B: Pero Jesús le respondió: «Acéptalo por ahora. Así es como nos corresponde cumplir toda justicia».
es.R: Jesús le respondió: «Deja que sea así por ahora. Debemos hacer todo lo que es justo a los ojos de Dios, y esto es parte de ello».

fr.L: Mais répondant, Jésus lui dit : « Laisse [faire] maintenant, car c’est ainsi qu’il nous convient d’accomplir toute justice. »
fr.B: Mais Jésus lui répondit : « Accepte pour l’instant. C’est ainsi qu’il convient que nous accomplissions toute justice. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a répondu : « Laisse faire pour le moment. Nous devons faire tout ce qui est juste aux yeux de Dieu, et cela en fait partie. »

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akijibu, alimwambia, "Ruhusu [hili] sasa, kwa sababu kwa njia hii inafaa kwetu kutimiza haki yote."
sw.B: Lakini Yesu alijibu, "Liruhusu kwa sasa. Hii ndiyo njia inayotufaa ya kutimiza haki yote."
sw.R: Yesu alimjibu, "Acha iwe hivyo kwa sasa. Tunapaswa kufanya kila jambo lililo la haki machoni pa Mungu, na hili ni sehemu yake."

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 대답하여 그에게 말씀하셨다. "지금은 [그렇게] 하도록 두어라. 이렇게 하여 모든 의를 이루는 것이 우리에게 마땅하기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 대답하셨다. "지금은 그렇게 하여라. 우리가 이렇게 해서 모든 의를 이루는 것이 마땅하다."
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "지금은 이렇게 하자. 우리는 하나님께서 바라시는 의를 모두 이루어야 한다. 이 일도 그 가운데 하나다."

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu trả lời, nói với ông: "Bây giờ hãy cứ để [vậy], vì như thế là thích hợp cho chúng ta để làm trọn mọi sự công chính."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Bây giờ hãy cứ làm như vậy, vì chúng ta nên làm trọn mọi sự công chính theo cách này."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Bây giờ cứ để như vậy đi. Chúng ta phải làm mọi điều công chính theo ý Đức Chúa Trời, và việc này là một phần trong đó."

am.L: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አለው፦ «ለአሁኑ ፍቀድ፤ በዚህ መንገድ ጽድቅን ሁሉ መፈጸም ለእኛ ተገቢ ነውና።»
am.B: ኢየሱስ ግን እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት፦ «ለጊዜው ይሁን፤ ጽድቅን ሁሉ ለመፈጸም ለእኛ ተገቢው መንገድ ይህ ነው።»
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት፦ «ለአሁኑ እንዲህ ይሁን። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትክክል የሆነውን ሁሉ ማድረግ ይገባናል፤ ይህም የዚያ አንዱ ክፍል ነው።»

decisions.choice: fulfill all righteousness: do all that God wills and requires
alternatives: carry out God's plan to save his people
keep every rule of the law
decisions.reason: In Matthew righteousness is doing God's will (5:6, 10, 20; 6:33). Jesus, though greater than John, takes his place with the people who come in obedience to God's call. Some see a wider sense: completing God's saving purpose.

decisions.choice: us: Jesus and John together
decisions.reason: Both have a part: John in baptizing and Jesus in being baptized.

decisions.choice: now: for the present
decisions.reason: The word says the order John expected is set aside for the time being.

decisions.choice: do everything that is righteous in God's eyes
decisions.reason: "Fulfill righteousness" is not plain English. Readable keeps the key word and says whose standard is meant.

decisions.choice: "의" at every level; Readable adds "하나님께서 바라시는"
decisions.reason: "의" is a key term and keeps the same word at every level (docs/korean-style.md section 6); Readable explains it with what God wants, as the meaning decision describes (all that God wills and requires).

decisions.choice: "làm trọn mọi sự công chính" (L, B); "làm mọi điều công chính theo ý Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: "Công chính" is the key term for righteousness; Readable adds "theo ý Đức Chúa Trời" from the meaning decision (all that God wills).

decisions.choice: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትክክል የሆነውን ሁሉ (all that is right in God's sight, R); ጽድቅን ሁሉ (L, B)
decisions.reason: "ጽድቅ" is the key word for righteousness and stays at Literal and Balanced. Here it means doing what God wills, so Readable says that, as the English Readable does.

es.R: Así que Juan aceptó bautizar a Jesús.

fr.B: Alors Jean {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} laissa se faire baptiser.
fr.R: Alors Jean a accepté de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} baptiser.

ko.B: 그러자 요한은 예수께서 세례를 받으시도록 했다.

vi.B: Bấy giờ Giăng chịu làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy Giăng đồng ý làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: permits him: allows him to be baptized
decisions.reason: The verb is the one Jesus used: "permit it". John gives way.

decisions.choice: let him be baptized (B); agreed to baptize him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what John permitted.

decisions.choice: a Jesús
decisions.reason: The pronoun joined to the infinitive ("bautizarlo") could not carry the deity_pronoun setting, and the name is clearer for new readers; the sense is the same as the English "baptize him".

source.text: βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ εἶδεν πνεῦμα θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν ἐρχόμενον ἐπ’ αὐτόν·

records.literal_gloss: Having been baptized then the Jesus immediately went up from the water; and behold, were opened the heavens, and he saw Spirit of God descending as a dove coming upon him;

en.L: And when Jesus had been baptized, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} immediately went up from the water, and look, the heavens were opened, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw [the] Spirit of God descending like a dove, coming upon {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Jesus was baptized, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came straight up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens opened, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and settling on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: After Jesus was baptized, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came up out of the water right away. Then heaven opened, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the Spirit of God coming down on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like a dove.

es.L: Y habiendo sido bautizado, Jesús subió en seguida del agua; y mira, se abrieron los cielos, y vio [al] Espíritu de Dios descender como una paloma, viniendo sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Jesús fue bautizado y salió enseguida del agua. De pronto se abrieron los cielos, y vio al Espíritu de Dios que bajaba como una paloma y se posaba sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Después de ser bautizado, Jesús salió enseguida del agua. Entonces se abrió el cielo, y vio al Espíritu de Dios que bajaba sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} como una paloma.

fr.L: Et ayant été baptisé, Jésus remonta aussitôt de l’eau ; et voici, les cieux furent ouverts, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit l’Esprit de Dieu descendre comme une colombe, venant sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Dès qu’il eut été baptisé, Jésus sortit de l’eau. Soudain les cieux s’ouvrirent, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit l’Esprit de Dieu descendre comme une colombe et se poser sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Après avoir été baptisé, Jésus est tout de suite sorti de l’eau. Alors le ciel s’est ouvert, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu l’Esprit de Dieu descendre sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme une colombe.

sw.L: Na Yesu, baada ya kubatizwa, mara moja alitoka majini; na tazama, mbingu zilifunguliwa, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} aliona Roho wa Mungu akishuka mfano wa njiwa, akija juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Yesu alipobatizwa, alitoka majini mara moja. Ghafula mbingu zikafunguka, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akamwona Roho wa Mungu akishuka kama njiwa na kutua juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Baada ya Yesu kubatizwa, alitoka majini mara moja. Kisha mbingu zikafunguka, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akamwona Roho wa Mungu akishuka juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama njiwa.

ko.L: 예수께서 세례를 받으시고 곧 물에서 올라오셨다. 그리고 보라, 하늘들이 열렸고, 그분은 하나님의 영이 비둘기처럼 내려와 자기 위에 오시는 것을 보셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 세례를 받으시고 곧바로 물에서 올라오셨다. 그때 하늘이 열리고, 예수께서는 하나님의 영이 비둘기처럼 내려와 자신 위에 머무르시는 것을 보셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 세례를 받으시고 바로 물에서 올라오셨다. 그때 하늘이 열렸다. 예수께서는 하나님의 영이 비둘기처럼 자신에게 내려오시는 것을 보셨다.

vi.L: Và sau khi chịu báp-têm, Đức Giê-xu lập tức lên khỏi nước; và kìa, các tầng trời mở ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng xuống như chim bồ câu, đến trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chịu báp-têm xong, Đức Giê-xu liền lên khỏi nước. Bỗng các tầng trời mở ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng xuống như chim bồ câu và đậu trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Sau khi chịu báp-têm, Đức Giê-xu liền từ dưới nước đi lên. Lúc ấy, bầu trời mở ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời ngự xuống trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như một con chim bồ câu.

am.L: ኢየሱስም ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያውኑ ከውኃው ወጣ፤ እነሆም፣ ሰማያት ተከፈቱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ እየወረደ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አየ።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ተጠምቆ ወዲያውኑ ከውኃው ወጣ። ድንገትም ሰማይ ተከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ወርዶ በእርሱ ላይ ሲያርፍ አየ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያውኑ ከውኃው ወጣ። በዚያን ጊዜ ሰማይ ተከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ሆኖ በእርሱ ላይ ሲወርድ አየ።

decisions.choice: the heavens were opened: God shows himself and speaks
decisions.reason: When heaven opens in Scripture, God is giving a vision or coming to help (Ezekiel 1:1; Isaiah 64:1).

decisions.choice: like a dove: the Spirit's coming is compared to a dove
alternatives: the Spirit took the bodily form of a dove (Luke 3:22)
decisions.reason: Matthew says only that the Spirit came down like a dove; it may describe the Spirit's form or the way it came down. Luke says "in bodily form".

decisions.choice: the Spirit upon him: God's Spirit resting on his chosen one
decisions.reason: Isaiah promised that God's Spirit would rest on the branch from Jesse (Isaiah 11:2) and on God's servant (Isaiah 42:1). Matthew quotes the second passage of Jesus in 12:18.

decisions.choice: the heavens were opened, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the heavens were opened to him, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "to him". The SBLGNT leaves it out. Either way Jesus is the one who sees. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: look (L); suddenly (B); then (R) (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses this word to point to what comes next. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal uses "look", and Balanced and Readable carry its force in the flow of the sentence, as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: mira (L); de pronto (B); entonces (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20 and the English: "he aquí" is archaic. Literal keeps the word with "mira"; Balanced and Readable carry it with a time word, as the English does. The same in 3:17.

decisions.choice: tazama (L); ghafula (B); kisha (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20: Literal keeps the word that draws attention; Balanced and Readable carry it with a time word, as the English does ("suddenly", "then"). The same in 3:17.

decisions.choice: "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for "immediately"; "하나님의 영" with the honorific
decisions.reason: The words for "immediately" used through the Korean Mark. The Spirit of God takes the honorific ("내려오시는"), as the Holy Spirit does in Mark 1:10.

decisions.choice: "lập tức" (L); "liền" (B, R) for "immediately"
decisions.reason: The word settled for Literal in the Gospels, as in Mark; Balanced and Readable use the shorter "liền". The same in 4:20 and 4:22.

decisions.choice: "các tầng trời" (L, B); "bầu trời" (R) for the heavens
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:10: the plural keeps the Greek "heavens", which opened to show God at work; Readable says the sky.

decisions.choice: ሰማያት (the heavens, L); ሰማይ (heaven, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has the plural, which Literal keeps. In ordinary Amharic the sky and heaven are one "ሰማይ", so Balanced and Readable use the singular, as in 3:17.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα.

records.literal_gloss: And behold, a voice out of the heavens saying, This is the son of me the beloved, in whom I was well pleased.

en.L: And look, a voice out of the heavens, saying, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, the beloved, in whom I am well pleased."
en.B: And a voice spoke from heaven: "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dearly loved Son, and I delight in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Then a voice from heaven said, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, and I love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. I am very pleased with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Y mira, una voz desde los cielos que decía: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, el amado, en quien me complazco».
es.B: Y una voz habló desde el cielo: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo muy amado; en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me deleito».
es.R: Entonces una voz desde el cielo dijo: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, y yo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} amo. Estoy muy contento con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

fr.L: Et voici, une voix [venant] des cieux, disant : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, le bien-aimé, en qui je prends plaisir. »
fr.B: Et une voix se fit entendre du ciel : « Celui-ci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils bien-aimé ; en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} je trouve {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} joie. »
fr.R: Puis une voix venant du ciel a dit : « Voici {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, et je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aime. Je suis très content de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »

sw.L: Na tazama, sauti kutoka mbinguni, ikisema, "Huyu ndiye Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, yule mpendwa, ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} nimefurahishwa."
sw.B: Na sauti ilinena kutoka mbinguni: "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mpendwa sana; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ananifurahisha."
sw.R: Kisha sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, "Huyu ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami ninampenda. Ninapendezwa sana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}."

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 하늘들에서 소리가 [나서] 말하였다. "이는 내 아들, 사랑하는 [아들]이다. 내가 그를 기뻐한다."
ko.B: 그리고 하늘에서 이렇게 말하는 소리가 들렸다. "이는 내가 사랑하는 아들이다. 나는 그를 기뻐한다."
ko.R: 그때 하늘에서 소리가 들렸다. "이는 내 아들이다. 나는 그를 사랑한다. 나는 그를 무척 기뻐한다."

vi.L: Và kìa, có tiếng từ các tầng trời phán rằng: "Đây là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, [Con] yêu dấu, Đấng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rất đẹp lòng."
vi.B: Và có tiếng từ trời phán: "Đây là Con yêu dấu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta rất vui lòng về Con ấy."
vi.R: Rồi có tiếng từ trời phán: "Đây là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} yêu thương Con ấy. Ta rất hài lòng về Con ấy."

am.L: እነሆም፣ ከሰማያት እንዲህ የሚል ድምፅ [መጣ]፦ «ይህ ልጄ፣ የምወደው ነው፤ በእርሱም ደስ ተሰኘሁ።»
am.B: ከሰማይም እንዲህ የሚል ድምፅ ተሰማ፦ «እጅግ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፤ በእርሱም ደስ ይለኛል።»
am.R: ከዚያም ከሰማይ አንድ ድምፅ እንዲህ አለ፦ «ይህ ልጄ ነው፤ እወደዋለሁ። በእርሱም እጅግ ደስ ብሎኛል።»

decisions.choice: my Son ... in whom I am well pleased: Psalm 2:7 and Isaiah 42:1
decisions.reason: In Psalm 2:7 God says to his anointed king, "You are my son." In Isaiah 42:1 God speaks of his servant, "in whom my soul delights", on whom he puts his Spirit (3:16). The voice calls Jesus both the king and the servant. "Beloved" may also recall Abraham's beloved son Isaac (Genesis 22:2).

decisions.choice: I am well pleased: a settled delight
alternatives: I was pleased at one moment in the past
decisions.reason: The past tense expresses God's delight as decided and complete, not limited to one moment.

decisions.choice: This is: the voice speaks about Jesus to those present
decisions.reason: Mark 1:11 and Luke 3:22 have "You are". In Matthew the voice announces who Jesus is, as at the transfiguration (17:5).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew uses this word to point to what comes next. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal uses "look", and Balanced and Readable carry its force in the flow of the sentence, as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: Son with a capital letter
decisions.reason: When God calls Jesus his Son, the word is a title, written with a capital letter as in John. In 2:15 the quotation from Hosea keeps the lower case, since there it first spoke of Israel.

decisions.choice: God speaks of his Son in 해라체 with "그를", worded as the Korean Mark 1:11 apart from "이는"
decisions.reason: As a father speaks of his son, God does not use the honorific of the Son; Matthew has "This is" where Mark has "You are", and the Korean changes only that.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" for himself (with the setting) and "Con ấy" (that Son) for "him"; the verb is "phán"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 9:7: "Con" is a noun, capitalised, and takes no setting span; Vietnamese would not have God call his Son "Ngài". In Matthew the voice speaks about Jesus, not to him as in Mark 1:11.
